Senses.Explanation: A shimmering mirage is the appearance of water produced by heat over dry ground. The Collected Essentials compares Xuefeng’s repeated journeys to a thirsty deer chasing a mirage. Other Chan records list the mirage with illusion or put waves on it. The thirsty-deer clause supplies the ordinary visual mistake; the shorter formulas show how widely the image is redeployed without explaining it each time.
